info.title: Adaptive Factory Local Semantic Validation API
info.description: Bounded local-only M6 semantic validation API. The frozen M4 control API and M5 execution APIs remain separately contracted.

post.description: Publishes one exact M5-bound semantic subject. Required scope: semantic:publish. A dedicated coordinator capability is also required.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Caller-supplied bounded correlation; invalid values are rejected.

get.description: Reads a bounded digest-verified semantic subject. Required scope: semantic:read. Repository authority is also required.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: If omitted or invalid values are discarded and replaced with a generated bounded correlation.

post.description: Creates one immutable independent-validator assignment. Required scope: semantic:assign. The coordinator capability is also required.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Caller-supplied bounded correlation; invalid values are rejected.

403.description: scope, kind, repository, or capability denied

post.description: Atomically appends an assignment-bound finding and full-coverage bundle. Required scope: semantic:validate. The validator capability is also required.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Caller-supplied bounded correlation; invalid values are rejected.

200.description: exact atomic evidence bundle or exact replay

403.description: scope, validator identity, repository, or capability denied

404.description: assignment or semantic subject not found

post.description: Recomputes a deterministic verdict only from persisted canonical evidence and appends it. Required scope: semantic:adjudicate. The adjudicator capability is also required.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Caller-supplied bounded correlation; invalid values are rejected.

200.description: exact deterministic verdict or exact replay

403.description: scope, kind, repository, or capability denied

404.description: semantic subject or complete evidence set not found

409.description: persisted evidence, verdict, or replay conflict

get.description: Reads a digest-verified persisted semantic verdict. Required scope: semantic:read. Repository authority is also required.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: If omitted or invalid values are discarded and replaced with a generated bounded correlation.

bearerAuth.description: Local bearer token loaded from a private no-follow token file.

capabilities.description: Sorted unique validator capabilities. Runtime validation requires repository_read and semantic_validate and rejects application_write, adjudicate, external_write, network, and credential_read.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit timezone.
